document.title: BRS-201506 Checking dimension Frame and Ring Plate
document.purpose: Investigate reason of NG Function by checking Frame and Ring Plate dimensions.
content: Measure Frame: Length 18.00-18.02 spec / Width 10.73-10.76 spec

conclusions.statement_from_report: Measurement of Frame Length 18.02-18.04, Width 10.75-10.77 vs spec Length 18.00-18.02 / Width 10.73-10.76.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: Frame Length AVG 18.026 mm exceeds upper spec 18.02 mm by 0.006 mm; MAX 18.04 mm is 0.02 mm above spec. Width AVG 10.762 mm just above 10.76 mm upper limit, MAX 10.77 mm. Frame is oversized vs spec - candidate cause of NG Function.

conclusions.statement_from_report: Ring Plate Length AVG 14.017, Width AVG 9.845.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: Ring Plate measurements are within stated spec (Length 13.97-14.03, Width 9.81-9.87). No dimensional defect for Ring Plate.

suggested_checks.check_item: Tighten Frame press die for Length and Width (target 18.00-18.02 / 10.73-10.76)
suggested_checks.reason: 5/5 Frame samples show Length 18.02-18.04 and Width 10.75-10.77, all on or above upper spec.
All Ring Plate measurements within spec.

assumptions: Two measurements per sample (left/right or two points) preserved as paired.
warnings: No Normal baseline - judged purely against the printed spec band.
ai_extraction_log.decision_rationale: Frame Length and Width both ride at or above upper spec on all 5 samples. Ring Plate within spec. Frame oversize is the likely dimensional contributor to NG Function under investigation.

document.title: BRS-201506 Frame과 Ring Plate 치수 점검
document.purpose: NG Function 원인을 찾기 위해 Frame과 Ring Plate 치수 측정.

k1.normalized_interpretation: Length AVG 18.026mm로 상한 18.02 +0.006mm 초과, MAX 18.04. Width AVG 10.762, MAX 10.77 - 상한 초과. Frame이 스펙보다 큼 → NG Function 후보 원인.

k2.normalized_interpretation: Ring Plate는 스펙 내. 치수 결함 없음.

warnings: Normal baseline 없음 - 인쇄된 스펙으로만 판정.
log.decision_rationale: 5/5 샘플 Frame Length, Width 상한 이상. Ring Plate는 OK. Frame 오버사이즈가 NG Function 후보 원인.

document.title: BRS-201506 Kiểm tra kích thước Frame và Ring Plate
document.purpose: Tìm nguyên nhân NG Function bằng cách đo Frame và Ring Plate.

k1.normalized_interpretation: Length AVG 18.026 mm vượt trên giới hạn 18.02 (+0.006), MAX 18.04. Width AVG 10.762, MAX 10.77 - vượt giới hạn trên. Frame quá khổ → ứng viên nguyên nhân NG Function.

hint_1.check_item: Giữ nguyên công đoạn Ring Plate
